name: mediadesk
description: MediaDesk — local photo and video organization for Windows
author: MediaDesk

scripts.publish:service:lean: dotnet publish src/MediaLibrary.Service/MediaLibrary.Service.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -p:NuGetLockFilePath=../../artifacts/service-framework-dependent.lock.json -o artifacts/service-release-app --nologo
scripts.build:webview: npm run publish:service:lean && npm run build:renderer && node scripts/build-webview.mjs && dotnet publish apps/webview/MediaLibrary.WebView/MediaLibrary.WebView.csproj -c Release --self-contained false -o artifacts/webview-app --nologo
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.webview.json
